messages:
maya: Heads-up — during q6b quant bring-up we noticed a cluster of golden examples that pair oddly with the long-context prompts. Can we sync on pairing rules before the weekend label run?

tj: saw that too. Some of the paired prompts are near-duplicates after tokenization, so labeler noise spikes.

oliver: quick data point: 120/2.4k golden pairs collapsed to the same tokenized prefix with tokenizer v2. Small edits changed meaning but dedupe flagged them.

kira: is this the short-prefix kvcache problem or a tokenizer mismatch?

maya: more tokenizer mismatch than kvcache. The quantized kernel trimming caused minor whitespace normalization differences in the canonicalization step.

oliver: repro snippet: 
``` 
# token diff
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('v2.json').encode('Q6B sample:  hello').tokens)"
```

kira: ugh. that explains why the golden comparator thinks some distinct prompts are duplicates. We should not dedupe on raw tokens for now.

tj: proposal: revert dedupe to fuzzy-similarity over normalized text and move token-level dedupe to a later pass. Set dedupe_threshold to 0.78 for this sweep.

maya: agreed. Also adding a small canary to the eval harness: run pairwise diffs on a 500-example holdout prior to sending to labelers. If >3% changes, abort.

labeler-bot: reminder — scheduled label batch "weekend-golden-pairing-2" will start 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC unless cancelled. React :warning: to cancel.

oliver: can we shift labelers to a lighter batch? The noisy pairs need human adjudication, not batch labeling.

kira: we can split: trusted golden pairs -> normal batch; fuzzy pairs -> review queue with 2 reviewers per example. Need ETA on creating the review queue.

tj: i'll patch the sampler today — it will output two files: golden_trusted.json and golden_review.json. Command: `./sampler/build_pairs.py --threshold 0.78 --outdir /tmp/golden_split`

maya: add one more guard: the review queue must include original raw text + tokenized forms from both tokenizers (v1 and v2) so labelers see differences.

oliver: noted. i'll update the labeling UI payload to show both.

kira: what's the impact on q6b quant canaries? Our canary runs failed 2/3 times this morning due to prefix truncation.

maya: ops note: kernel team is rolling a micro-patch to avoid trimming leading spaces in the canonicalizer; patch id: kernel-2026-03-20-17. If it lands, rerun canaries and the sampler.

tj: schedule: patch in canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC, sampler rebuild 08:00 UTC, labeler start 10:00 UTC. If anything flakes, hold label start.

labeler-bot: batch "weekend-golden-pairing-2" status: pending. Next automated update in 30m.

maya: final asks: (1) oliver — add the dual-tokenizer fields to review payload by EOD, (2) tj — change dedupe_threshold to 0.78 and emit split files, (3) kira — confirm reviewers for the fuzzy queue and put doc in the ops runbook. I'll coordinate comms to label team.

oliver: on it.

kira: assigning reviewers: @nina, @sam, @diego. I'll ping them.

tj: opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sampler/pull/442 — includes threshold flag + split output. CI green.

maya: thanks — i'll wait for kernel patch before flipping anything production. If the patch doesn't merge, we fallback to text-normalized dedupe and smaller review quota.

labeler-bot: automod: please avoid posting PII in labeling queues.

maya: noted. thanks team. We'll reconvene if the canary fails after the kernel patch.

tj: thanks — i'll post updates in this thread as things land.
